svg.aria-label: Paper-cutout card split by a vertical divider. Left: an orange robot proudly fills a dense, overflowing chalkboard with equations while a human stares up with mouth open, pointing in disbelief. Right: a plain teal robot lowers a folded note into a tip box beside a torn, dust-speckled two-month calendar, with a small "Unnoticed" tag beneath the box.
